seo.title: Who really got rich from the biggest diamond ever found?
seo.description:
Frederick Wells discovered a 3,106-carat diamond just 18 feet underground, but mine owner Thomas Cullinan and the British monarchy reaped the massive wealth. 1905 records highlight the extreme disparity between the finder and the beneficiaries.

#History #Diamonds #HistoricalFacts
